mentions.name: StatsBrowser
mentions.description: A browser-based statistical analysis suite built on webR that provides step-by-step guides for running statistical tests and insights on results that highlight common statistical pitfalls.
mentions.problem: Traditional stats apps are difficult for students to use.
mentions.audience: Students who struggle with traditional stats apps
mentions.source_excerpt:
StatsBrowser: https://www.statsbrowser.com

A statistical analysis suite that runs in the browser via webR. It provides step-by-step guides for running tests and insights on results containing statistical pitfalls. Aimed at students who struggle with traditional stats apps.
